race.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: TAM LIN shaped well after an absence on his first start for Mick Appleby when a recent Southwell fourth, fading only late on, and looks the way to go here with that run under his belt. C&D scorer Rovinia is next on the list, while in-form maiden Orange Emperor and multiple course winner Dandy Khan can also play a prominent role. TAM LIN (IRE) ROVINIA ORANGE EMPEROR (IRE)
